events.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid board scandal; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO, shares fall sharply
US tightens AI-chip export rule blocking remote access via Southeast Asian data centers as Nvidia halts China H200 shipments; AI-stock selloff deepens, S&P 500 near lowest close since July
Oil prices fall as Strait of Hormuz flows recover; IEA now forecasts a Q4 2026 supply surplus of ~1.7m bpd despite continued (unverified) Iranian tanker/mine incidents
China extends suspension of rare-earth and battery-material export controls to January 10, 2027, easing US/EU supply-chain risk
FOMC minutes show officials leaning toward a December rate hike amid elevated inflation; markets price ~90% odds of a hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting
